set.body:
Use scoped indexed reads while preserving the pure evaluator and the current 64 KiB delivery boundary.

Acceptance criteria

1. Compare decisions with the pure oracle for fixed grants, dataset scope, membership, expiry, disabled sessions, lifecycle and upstream restrictions. Hidden rows never change authorized counts or cursor output.
2. Show through query plans and measured rows that a chunk check no longer reloads institution-wide state, and a page does not materialize all organization history. Repeat the frozen baseline at both population sizes.
3. Revoke or expire permission during a long transfer. The next chunk authorization observes the change and the existing cancellation/resource limits still hold.
4. Report before/after results against applicable frozen budgets. Record wider workload failures for H04.2. Preserve content hashes and upgrade compatibility.

Verification

Scope/latency/row-count comparisons with identical workloads, oracle decisions and midstream revocation receipts.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: OPS02: Bound policy evaluation and directory reads to the authorized scope
